verdict.rationale: Ironclad offers a documented signature product ('Contract Signing Has Never Been Easier'), workflow launch APIs, and BYOSP routing to custom signature providers, indicating support for launching multi-recipient e-signature workflows with routing logic. However, evidence lacks explicit documentation of multi-recipient routing/sequencing configuration (e.g., signing order, parallel vs sequential routing) or founder-friendly UI walkthroughs for this specific flow. missing for 10: explicit docs on multi-signer routing/sequencing UI or API parameters, independent hands-on confirmation of e-signature routing across multiple recipients.
